blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — The body of a missing 9-year-old boy was recovered from the Pansipit River near the municipal boundaries of Agoncillo and Lemery in Batangas on Monday afternoon (Oct. 26), a day after his disappearance was reported. The Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) Batangas said the boy’s body was found near Palanas Bridge in Lemery at 3:20 p.m. READ: Body of last missing Batangas jeepney passenger recovered According to initial accounts from the family, the boy tried to rescue his brother, who was reportedly swept by the river current toward a deeper section of the Pansipit River.
